en: Hello there! See that hole in the cliff? They say a great tower once stood here, half of it buried in the rock.
It reached up into the sky and down into the earth, and some say right to the bottom of the sea.
It's crumbled away now. All that's left is the way in and a room full of strange patterns.
I reckon it was built to honour Pokémon bound up with the sea, the land and the sky.
